origin.description: Alias of checkDataFrame. Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is a data frame.
origin.usage: check_data_frame(x, types = character(0L), any.missing = TRUE, all.missing = TRUE, min.rows = NULL, max.rows = NULL, min.cols = NULL, max.cols = NULL, nrows = NULL, ncols = NULL, row.names = NULL, col.names = NULL, null.ok = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: types
arguments.text: Storage mode required for each list element or column.

arguments.name: any.missing
arguments.text: When false, any missing value fails the check.

arguments.name: all.missing
arguments.text: When false, a completely missing value fails the check.

origin.details: Alias of checkDataFrame. Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is a data frame.
origin.value: True, or a message describing the first failure.
